d.ko: To aid the King, Priestess Konoha plunges into "Grimoire"! The world inside "Grimoire" is formed by another world called Grimoire Land in which Konoha becomes a magical girl, and has come to save the world!
d.en: To aid the King, Priestess Konoha plunges into "Grimoire"! The world inside "Grimoire" is formed by another world called Grimoire Land in which Konoha becomes a magical girl, and has come to save the world!
d.zh:
为了拯救被「魔导书格里默阿」引导的国王莱昂，神官木叶奋不顾身地进入书的世界。
书中是名为格里默阿岛的异世界，降临于此处的木叶转生为魔法少女，
面对数不胜数的未知，木叶开始了拯救世界的冒险。
